name: felt-promo
description: Felt promo video, built with Remotion

scripts.render: remotion render FeltPromoVertical out/felt-promo-vertical.mp4 && remotion render FeltPromoLandscape out/felt-promo-landscape.mp4
scripts.stills: remotion still FeltPromoVertical out/still-1-mark.png --frame=76 && remotion still FeltPromoVertical out/still-2-chart.png --frame=198 && remotion still FeltPromoVertical out/still-3-drill.png --frame=322 && remotion still FeltPromoVertical out/still-4-rating.png --frame=442 && remotion still FeltPromoVertical out/still-5-phone.png --frame=526 && remotion still FeltPromoVertical out/still-6-end.png --frame=592
scripts.stills:landscape: remotion still FeltPromoLandscape out/landscape-1-mark.png --frame=76 && remotion still FeltPromoLandscape out/landscape-2-chart.png --frame=198 && remotion still FeltPromoLandscape out/landscape-3-drill.png --frame=322 && remotion still FeltPromoLandscape out/landscape-4-rating.png --frame=442 && remotion still FeltPromoLandscape out/landscape-5-phone.png --frame=526 && remotion still FeltPromoLandscape out/landscape-6-end.png --frame=592
